notes: Pairwise same-entity classifier over name, jurisdiction and missingness features. Reads NO identifier: every label in this project is derived from identifier agreement, so an identifier feature would be the answer, not evidence. The deterministic resolver remains authoritative for merges; this score is advisory and is always shown with its features.
thresholdPolicy: Chosen on the validation partition as the threshold maximising F1 subject to a false-merge rate no higher than the deterministic resolver's on the same partition (0.0009), AND no higher than that resolver's false-merge rate over the CURATED HARD NEGATIVES alone (2/67 = 0.0299). The second ceiling exists because hard negatives are 67 of the partition's negatives, so an overall ceiling alone barely constrains the pairs a merge decision actually turns on. The held-out partition was not consulted.
